rootCause.Trigger: The two-times source request from 0.8.44. With it off, MinerU reads Status 2, bounds 20-360 of 384, and every icon's SourceWidth is 60.
rootCause.Mechanism: In Explorer the 256 px list holds a 72 px picture for MinerU: request 120 returns 256x256 with bounds 96-160, the SHIL_JUMBO list returns bounds 4-68 in 256x256, request 60 returns 72x72 with bounds 4-68.
rootCause.NotEstablished: Why Explorer's list holds only the small picture. iconcache_256.db has 24 entries, all 256 px PNG, none undersized, one with bounds 15-241, the same as MinerU's full artwork, so the cache was not cleared.
